resources.string: This simulation starts when secretion of a generic circulating signal stops. It sets the starting level to 100 percent and assumes a constant half-life: each half-life removes half of what remains. The ticks are arbitrary, not physical time units. This is not the half-life of any named hormone or a patient result, and it does not model ongoing secretion or feedback.
Percent of starting signal remaining = 100 × 2^(−elapsed time ÷ half-life).
